productionTool: Canva generate-image + remove-background (scoped exception carried over from mission-v4/style-guide.md — 1 new asset only)
status: v1 free-play prototype: gather + pet-raising + village-building, all tabs freely switchable, no forced order, no correct/incorrect gate. Math-only (counting/quantity). Korean literacy explicitly deferred pending user confirmation of scope.

newAssets.usedIn: village.js PALETTE (build tab) — the most expensive buildable item (5 acorns + 2 berries)
newAssets.prompt: A cute 3D clay-style toy miniature cottage house, small round wooden cabin with a triangular thatched roof and a round door, smooth matte toy material, soft pastel cream and brown color palette, gentle studio lighting with soft shadows, centered single subject, three-quarter view, plain soft pastel solid background, no text, no realistic photography

reusedAssets: mission-v4/objects/berry_single.png (gather node, doubles as resource icon)
mission-v4/objects/acorn_single.png (resource icon, feed icon, cost chips)
mission-v4/objects/reward_flower.png (build palette item AND pet stage-2 crown decoration)

gameLoops.gather: Tap tree -> +1 acorn (state.acorns). Tap berry node -> +1 berry (state.berries). No limit, no cooldown, fully repeatable.
gameLoops.pet: Tap a feed icon (costs 1 of that resource) -> hunger +20 (capped 100), feedCount +1, bear shows happy PNG for ~850ms then reverts to waiting. feedCount>=5 unlocks visual stage 1 (slightly bigger), feedCount>=12 unlocks stage 2 (bigger + flower crown). No decay over time in v1 (hunger only goes up) — see notDone.
gameLoops.build: Tap a palette item. If state has enough of both resource costs, deduct and push {type} into state.buildings (rendered stacked in the plot, never removed). If not enough, button shakes once, no state change, no error text.

notDone: Korean literacy (자음/모음/띄어쓰기) content — user mentioned it as a parallel principle but didn't confirm folding it into this same game; deferred as a separate future game using the same free-play mechanic rather than guessing and building the wrong scope.
Single pet species only (bear, reusing mission-v4 asset) — no pet choice/selection screen.
Only 3 buildable item types (flower/basket/cottage) — no larger building variety or decoration categories.
Village plot auto-stacks placed items left-to-right/wrap; no drag-to-reposition, no removing a placed item once built.

Hunger only increases via feeding in v1 — no time-based decay, so there's no 'tend to your pet regularly' pressure yet (deliberately simple for v1; decay could make it feel more alive but also adds a notion of 'neglect' that needs careful framing for young kids).
No sound design beyond reusing the same simple beep pattern as mission.js's sfx() — no distinct village music/ambience.
Not linked from math-garden/index.html (the 15-game hub) yet — only reachable by direct URL until the user decides whether/how to surface it.
0-100 resource/building count scaling not stress-tested (only tested up to 5 acorns / 3 berries / 1 building in this round's QA).
